company.name: Solve Intelligence
company.shortDescription: Solve Intelligence is an artifical intelligence company that offers generative AI technology for writing patents.
company.description:
We use AI to help you write high-quality patents quickly. We do this by providing a simple in-browser document editor that any patent attorney or inventor can start using straight away.

Our product can help with all stages of the patent life cycle, from drafting and filing to prosecution and opposition.

If you are an an inventor, a patent attorney, or even just an enthusiast interested in the intersection of AI and intellectual property, we would love to hear from you: https://www.solveintelligence.com/contact
